stories.headline: Thousands rally in Istanbul marking one year since İmamoğlu's arrest

stories.headline: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan conducts Gulf tour addressing Iran-Israel conflict

stories.headline: Turkey destroys US-made unmanned vessel on Black Sea coast
stories.summary: Turkish authorities destroyed a US-made AEGIR-W unmanned surface vessel built by Sierra Nevada Corporation that washed ashore on Turkey's Black Sea coast. The incident highlights ongoing regional tensions and Turkey's defensive posture.

stories.headline: Central Bank issues open letter to Finance Minister on inflation targets
stories.summary: Turkey's Central Bank (TCMB) sent an open letter to Finance Minister Mehmet Şimşek explaining why 2025 inflation targets were missed and outlining monetary policy stance. The bank warned that policy could be tightened further if inflation outlook deteriorates significantly.

stories.headline: Super Şimşek tactical drone enters Turkish Air Force inventory

Operations targeted the group's financial networks and operational structures.

stories.headline: Finance Minister Şimşek warns of inflation risks from regional war
stories.summary: Finance Minister Mehmet Şimşek warned that continued conflict in the Middle East poses serious inflation risks for Turkey due to energy price impacts. He implemented proactive measures including fuel price controls but expressed concern about current account deficit pressures from rising oil prices.
